Integral Lefschetz, Poincaré duality, Wu classes and the indefinite even-lattice uniqueness criterion
correctness.rationale: A general flag in the eight-dimensional system of defining hyperplanes gives smooth intermediate sections (Bertini off the base locus, independence of differentials on it). Integral Lefschetz gives H_3(X)=0 and a surjection H_4(X)→H_4(Gr(2,8)); the target is free, so dualizing gives the primitive Schubert embedding. Universal coefficients and Poincaré duality give the torsion-free unimodular middle form. Independent total-Chern-class expansion and binomial coefficient extraction give Gram entries 62, 28, 14; Euler number 636 and c2 squared 692; the signature formula then gives 244 and the rank is 632. Signature 244 is not a multiple of eight, so the indefinite form is odd and has inertia (438,194). The degree-four Wu congruence with c1=0 makes c2=a+5b characteristic, and it is primitive by the primitive embedding. Consequently K is even. Primitive unimodular gluing identifies the discriminant groups by bilinear anti-isometry; if the A projection of an integral lift has dual coordinates (u,v), the square of its K projection is congruent to u+5v minus the A-square modulo 2. Inverting the Gram matrix gives exactly the displayed numerator and denominator. The Smith factors are (2,42), and the indefinite even lattice of signature (436,194) is in the uniqueness range rank 630 ≥ length 2 plus 2.
residual_risks: The model is the abstract lattice and primitive Schubert sublattice, not a geometric basis of the complement or a classification of algebraic cycle classes.

value.rationale: The integral complement of the natural ambient classes is a motivated invariant for the primitive middle cohomology of this family. The result distinguishes the even primitive complement from the odd total form and fixes its discriminant refinement, data not supplied by a Hodge diamond or by rational pairings. The characteristic class also settles whether c2/2 is integral. Neither table recomputation nor the abstract unimodular lattice on its own is the main contribution.
residual_risks: No consequences for a period map or full algebraic sublattice are established or needed for this assessment.
